presentation.guidance: Topic architecture opens with problem-domain analytical prose; direction is named at milestone granularity without mixing boundaries, module layout, or feature-level outcomes.

allowed.carrier: Causal analytical prose (trigger → current situation → cost of unresolved uncertainty → named topic direction)

forbidden: Scope or exclusion tables (belongs in BD)
Module or dependency diagrams (belongs in SH)
Decision comparison tables (belongs in KD)
Open-question tracking tables (belongs in OQ)
Before/after feature outcome tables (belongs in lulu-design GO)

required: States why architecture shaping happens now and what the current technical situation is
Names an observable topic-level architecture direction without file-level, interface-level, or task-level detail
forbidden: Opening paragraphs that lead with file:line or repository path inventories
Checkbox steps, Run commands, feature task breakdowns, or acceptance criteria

presentation.guidance: Boundaries express shaping scope for a multi-feature topic: in-scope capability domains, excluded architecture paths, and cross-feature invariants; each exclusion binds to what it protects.

allowed.carrier: Scope table (capability domain or system | shaping concern in scope)
Exclusion list (excluded architecture path | protected boundary/invariant)

forbidden: Feature change-mapping tables (belongs in lulu-design SC)
Module dependency diagrams (belongs in SH)
Trade-off reasoning with adopted/rejected paths (belongs in KD)
Open-assumption tracking (belongs in OQ)

required: Scope, exclusions, and invariants are distinguishable and non-contradictory
Each exclusion identifies the boundary or invariant it protects
forbidden: Repeating SI trigger narrative without boundary semantics
Single-feature solution scope framed as topic architecture

presentation.guidance: Structure content carries topic-level relationship semantics; select carrier by whether partition, dependency, or cross-boundary flow must be read without inference — not interface contracts or execution detail.

allowed.carrier: Module responsibility table (module/subsystem | responsibility | attachment point for future features)
Directed dependency table (dependent → coupling/boundary point → dependency)
Topic-level interaction boundary view (boundary | trigger | architectural end-state) when cross-feature flows matter

forbidden: Caller → interface → callee tables with field or API semantics (belongs in lulu-design IF)
Per-request or field-level state machines (belongs in lulu-design ST/IF)
Task steps, file edit lists, or Run commands (belongs in lulu-plan)
Decision rationale tables duplicating KD

required: Core modules or subsystems named with responsibility boundaries at topic granularity
When new components appear, names are identifiable system artifacts or explicitly marked as new
Future feature attachment points are visible without re-deriving partitions
forbidden: Placeholder names like 'some module' or 'related service'
Decorative diagrams with no structural semantics
Opening with decision rationale before structure is established (belongs in KD)
Feature-level before/after behavior specs

presentation.guidance: When multiple architecture paths were genuinely considered at topic level, a comparison structure carries trade-off semantics; single-path decisions may use analytical prose.

allowed.carrier: Architecture path comparison table (path | conclusion | trade-off rationale | reopen condition)
Analytical reasoning prose (single decision, no genuine alternatives)

forbidden: Module layout duplicating SH
Interface field specs or acceptance matrices (belongs in lulu-design)
Phase tags, Owner, or Timing tables (belongs in lulu-plan)

required: Architecture-level trade-off reasoning beyond stakeholder authorization alone
Rejected alternatives named when genuinely considered
Reopen or evolution conditions stated when reversibility matters
forbidden: Selected direction rationale consisting solely of authorization references
Repeating BD exclusion list without decision semantics
Feature implementation tactics or design patterns at lulu-design granularity

presentation.guidance: Open items carry topic-level tracking semantics: assumption or risk, related architecture gap, and whether the next feature cycle is blocked.

allowed.carrier: Open-item tracking table (item | related gap | blocks-next-cycle or non-blocking | closure condition)

forbidden: Run commands, test file paths, or checkbox steps
Closed decisions restated from KD
Acceptance or verification matrices (belongs in lulu-design VD)
blocks-plan labels (belongs in lulu-design OQ)

required: blocks-next-cycle or non-blocking label on each item
Closure condition or resolution path when status is non-blocking
forbidden: Items that only repeat SH/KD content without unresolved assumptions
Feature-level verification gaps without topic-level architecture impact
